Summary: Checks that your Intune policies configure the Level 1 recommendations of the CIS Microsoft Intune for Office Benchmark v1.1.0, one test per setting. It reads policy configuration, not device state.

Prerequisites.Text: PowerShell 7.4 or later and Maester 3.0 or later.
An account that can read Intune configuration, such as Global Reader or Intune Administrator.

Steps.Text: Connect Maester. Its default Graph scopes include everything this pack reads.

Options.Name: JLIntune.PolicyNameFilter
Options.Text: GlobalSettings: a wildcard such as 'W11-CIS-*'. Only policies whose name matches count, in every test that does not set its own PolicyNameFilter.

Options.Name: <test> PolicyNameFilter
Options.Text: The same filter for one test, in TestSettings.

Options.Name: <test> IncludeUnassigned
Options.Text: Count policies that are not assigned to anything.

Options.Name: <test> AllowConflicts
Options.Text: Pass even when another counted policy sets a value that does not meet the recommendation.

AppOnly.Text: Give the app the application permissions listed on this page, connect with Connect-MgGraph, and run Invoke-Maester -Pack JL.CISOFFINT.L1 -SkipBuiltIn -SkipGraphConnect -NonInteractive.
